text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I drop by the racecourse on my day off
and find
the track crowded with
Umamusume, waiting at
the ready. Just
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A runner zips by in a flash. I recognize
her... That's
Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is fierce and filled with
an
overwhelming thirst for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once she passes the halfway point of the
race,
she tears away from the
competition and lands an
easy win for
herself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Followers
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sirius! Your running today was
nothing short
of fantastic, as always!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, no need to make such a big deal.
This race
was nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli is swept up in a storm of
admirers
and reporters, who all shower
her with praise.
However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your win! You won
by such a
large margin!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It appears the Symboli in your name isn't
for
show! Will you be sharing the results
of this race
with your childhood friend,
Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it. You're one of the Emperor's
fans,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you tell her yourself? It's
better than
wasting your time with me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, that's not what I was implying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reporter scrambles to smooth things
over but
is cowed by Sirius Symboli's ire
and ends up
leaving the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, the Emperor... It feels
like the air
around Sirius Symboli
dropped a few degrees
after she heard
that name.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up with the sour looks?
Don't you
have a celebration party in
store for me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Followers
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes, of course! Let's make this a
party to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Also...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You there. You got something to say to
me?
You've been staring a hole through
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting called out throws me for a loop,
but I find
the right thing to respond with
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It was obvious I was going to win.
So, what
do you have for me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're here to celebrate my success,
aren't you?
So what are you going to do
for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I already congratulated her. What else
does she
expect from me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Hahaha! Don't get worked up over
such a
simple question!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I suppose those faces you pulled will do
for
today. Don't let me down next time,
though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I guess she's just messing with me.
Sirius Symboli
leaves in a jovial mood
after playing me for a
fool.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As strong as the rumors say? That's a
decent
compliment. But it's not good
enough.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What you should have said is that the
rumors
didn't do me any justice.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I need to teach you a few
things
about manners. For instance...
Yes, I know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Lend me your ear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite being more than confused, I
turn the side
of my face to her, thinking
she has something to
tell me, but when I
do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly reaches for my ear and
gently twists
it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That's how we Umamusume say
hello.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's important to greet people properly.
Make
sure you've mastered the right way
to say hello
the next time we meet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was bizarre... I'd never had
someone do that
to me before, and the
experience leaves my heart
racing for a
while.
